FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Savory Solutions Catering specializes in providing high-quality catering and food preparation services for a variety of events, including corporate functions, weddings, and community gatherings. We take pride in adhering to all local food safety regulations, including the FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), to ensure the highest standard of food safety and quality. Our operations emphasize documented ingredient sourcing and supplier certifications, allowing us to maintain traceability and effectively manage food safety risks.

We utilize commercial-grade equipment for food storage and transportation, ensuring that perishable goods are safely handled and served at the right temperatures. Our trained staff undergoes regular food safety training to reinforce proper handling procedures and maintain an incident response plan for food safety incidents. We conduct regular internal audits of our food safety practices, continually improving protocols to align with industry standards.

Savory Solutions Catering is dedicated to providing exceptional culinary experiences while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, thereby minimizing risks associated with foodborne illnesses. We regularly review our operations to enhance risk management practices and document our commitments to safety and quality for our clients.

Our catering and food preparation services provide a variety of meals without adhering to specific FDA FSMA requirements, allowing us to offer unique and creative recipes that are tailored to our clients' preferences.
